This game has been moved. IF YOU ARE JOINING FROM THE OLD GAME,  YOU STILL HAVE YOUR DATA!
🚨 HEADS UP: In order to play, make sure to turn on experience chat! 

🗽 From the White House to the Pentagon, Oath of Office™ is a politics simulation and roleplay game which places you at the top of the U.S. government. As a member of Congress or the Executive Branch, vote on laws or make decisions on issues that impact the nation - and your polls.

🏛️ CONGRESS: Join the House of Representatives to propose and vote on laws. Elect your leadership and Speaker of the House.

🦅 EXECUTIVE BRANCH: Attend meetings and make decisions on issues as an Assistant Secretary at an executive department. 

🧑‍⚖ JUDICIAL BRANCH: As a Federal Prosecutor or attorney, argue cases in front of federal judges or the Supreme Court.

🚨 Rules: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/red-parasol-rules-information/4589819
